countries.reasoning: China is the world’s largest magnesium producer, responsible for approximately 80% of global production as per USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries 2023. Data is highly reliable and consistent over recent years.
Russia is a significant producer of magnesium with established production facilities; data from USGS 2023 indicates around 6%, but some geopolitical uncertainties exist.
Israel produces magnesium primarily from its Dead Sea operations; production figures from 2022-2023 are well documented by industry sources.
Kazakhstan is an emerging magnesium producer with production data from national mining reports and USGS 2023; data is moderately confident but less comprehensive.
US production has declined but still accounts for a small share; data from USGS 2023 and industry reports support this estimate with moderate confidence.
